translated_text: Grand Café Glacier P. ICHÉ, OWNER First Brand Consumption MEETING ROOM PLACE DU 14 JUILLET PÉZENAS HÉRAULT TELEPHONE 1.30 14.5. Pézenas, 1940 My little darling, Today I haven't received your letter yet, but I'm still a little at peace after your letter. I don't know what it is, but every night I have a dream about you. It's for something else, not entirely unpleasant, but always about this need. Tell me how our baby is, is he still in pain? What is Mommy doing? You haven't written to me yet about how things are now with you. I hope everything is in order. And Pista, and Susanne, and Laci, etc., etc. Write to me, my love, and don't forget that I love you, your Bob. DUBON # DUBONNET PARIS 69 29 40 1530 DEVOUILLE 09 29 11 40 15 30- RUE VOUILLY -Lucien Robert Zweigenthal per RJ bei for Compagnie SP gigy VOJENSKÁ CENSURA Military Postal Control POST S AUX CN A
